moa: CD19-targeting CAR-T with proprietary fast-off rate (lower binding affinity) → high ALL response with lowest toxicity profile in CAR-T class (0% Grade ≥3 CRS); same MoA in autoimmune: CD19 B-cell depletion → immune reset → potential durable remission without chronic immunosuppression
indication: Systemic lupus erythematosus (autoimmune re-rating driver, not the approved ALL indication)
stage_full: Obe-cel (AUCATZYL) approved in r/r B-ALL: Q2 2026 net revenue $45.7M (+119% YoY), gross margin 55%, FY26 guidance raised to $140-150M. efficacy: AUCATZYL (approved ALL indication): real revenue, $26.2M Q1'26, positive gross margin, strong US+UK launch. Ph1 CARLYSLE (severe refractory SLE, all with refractory lupus nephritis, n=6): 83% achieved DORIS remission, 50% complete renal response — ALL responses/remissions ONGOING with NO evidence of disease activity at median 8.9-month follow-up; no ICANS, no high-grade CRS; steroids tapered to 5mg by month 6 in all patients. threat: KYV-101 (Kyverna Therapeutics) — directly competitive autologous CD19 CAR-T in SLE; Phase 2 lupus nephritis trial with topline data expected H1 2026; Kyverna is better funded and further along in Ph2 SLE enrollment; could file first for autoimmune indication and take first-mover reimbursement advantage.
